Case-I Turn Over vaJue is in increasing trend then average of the two Turn Over values must be equal to or more than the limiting Turn Over value of Rs. 0.23 lakh. Case-II Turn Over value is in decreasing trend then lower of the two Turn Over value.s must be equal to or more t han the limiting Turn Over value of Rs. 0.23 lakh.

However, both M SE and startups shall have to meet eligibility conditions for quality and technical specifications/requi rements. 3. The tenderer is required to submit self-attested photocopies of documents in support of their eligibility a nd experience along with the techno-commercial bid. In addition, bidder shall submit an affidavit in enclo sed format (Annexure-A) declaring that the documents submitted by them are genuine. 4. BSL reserves the right to call for original documents for verification at any time during tendering, evaluat ion and/or the execution of the contract.
